title_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 9)
description_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 9), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This lecture addresses theological arguments concerning divine transcendence beyond physical limits.
